description: Pinned portable mutable actor-state Oreslang guest fixture. Metadata only: the private .ores file is not duplicated; host tests and model tests are never backend execution evidence.

requirements.compiler: real Oreslang compiler must compile the pinned guest source (not a rewritten equivalent)
requirements.runtime: run emitted guest program and observe exact output and exit code
requirements.security: run inside approved repository/runner boundary; no private-source alternate-org mirroring
requirements.evidence: exact compiler/backend head, guest blob SHA, stepful build/run logs; local harness receipt alone is diagnostic
requirements.failClosed: do not mark a backend PASS on missing, skipped, zero-step or model-only execution
requirements.cranelift: Separate Rust Cranelift stage-0 is scalar-only: actor mutable state must fail closed until actor, borrow, async and scheduler lowering are implemented.
